blocks.text: Cloud computing ne businesses aur aam logon ke data sambhalne, process karne aur rakhne ka tareeqa bilkul badal diya hai. Is ke istemal bohat se sectors (kaam ke maidan) mein phaile hue hain, aur yeh aise hal dete hain jo zaroorat ke saath barh sakte hain (scalable) aur saste hain, jis se kaam behtar aur innovations (nayi cheezein aur naye tareeqe) aasan hoti hain.

Websites host karne aur applications chalane se le kar data storage aur mil kar kaam (collaboration) karne tak, cloud computing aaj ke digital daur ke bohat se zaroori kaam sambhalti hai. Cloud ki taqat istemal kar ke organizations apna kaam streamline (aasan aur seedha) kar sakte hain, IT ka kharcha kam kar sakte hain aur badalti zarooraton ka jaldi jawab de sakte hain. Yeh hissa dekhta hai ke cloud computing ke alag alag istemal industries aur rozmarra zindagi ko kaise badal rahe hain.

blocks.prompt: Google Drive par file share karte waqt aap cloud ka kaunsa istemal kar rahe hain?
blocks.explanation: Data storage (6.3.1.1): file door ke servers par rakhi jati hai aur kahin se bhi kholi aur share ki ja sakti hai.

items: Cloud ke istemal: data storage, web hosting aur content delivery, ML aur AI.
Faide: kam IT kharcha, tez jawab, zaroorat ke saath barhna.
